psygun.name: Blaster
psygun.does: Fire with LMB; hold RMB to lock on
psygun.detail: Full auto on LMB. Hold RMB to lock on to up to 8 targets; release fires a lance at each.

soulbrush.name: Absorb
soulbrush.does: Eats enemy shots of your colour
soulbrush.detail: A fan of spray ahead. Enemy shots of your colour inside it are drunk, and it cuts up to three small fish.

crucibelle.name: Bomb
crucibelle.detail: A ring that clears every shot around you, wider on the beat. It scatters fish and staggers boarders.

lockheart.name: Vacuum
lockheart.does: Sucks in shots and small fish; refills energy
lockheart.detail: Swallows a cone ahead for a second: enemy shots and the smallest fish. Each one refills 2 energy.

veritome.name: Flash
veritome.does: Opens weak points for a few seconds
veritome.detail: Takes a photo of what is in view and holds a weak point open. A boss photographed goes in your Compendium.

sondelass.name: Grapple
sondelass.does: Pulls loot in; yanks boarders off
sondelass.detail: Hooks what you aim at: loot and casks are reeled aboard, and a boarder is yanked into the sea.

dreamvane.name: Radar
dreamvane.detail: Always on. Attack warnings come half again as early, and it marks the school's leader and a big creature about to surface.

espada.does: a wider window to send the spit back

psygun.does: the bow gun: aimed with the camera, the height found for you

sondelass.does: a harpoon: a beast tethered cannot dive and its ram is blunted; a crate hooked is reeled aboard

crucibelle.does: the toll: every windup inside the ring broken, its beast staggered 2 s (a parry at range)

lockheart.does: the gulp: a spit drunk and carried back on the next shot (x3); the umibozu's sea drunk out of the hull

dreamvane.does: sonar: every dive within reach shows where it will surface, 2 s early; salvage and caches show under the water; read through ink

veritome.does: flash: a weak point held open, and a plate taken (in a habit, its bonus)

soulbrush.does: a slick laid astern: a beast swimming through it is slowed by half for 3 s (kite it through your wake)
